# writer

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/logger/writer"
```

Package writer activates the dependency\-free logger writers — "console", "file", and "rotfile" — by blank\-importing their service factory packages. A single

```
import _ "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/logger/writer"
```

registers all three factories so logger.NewMulti can resolve the "console", "file", and "rotfile" names. It pulls NO third\-party dependencies; the AWS writers \(s3, cloudwatch\) live in separate third\-party/aws/writer packages that a consumer imports individually when — and only when — they want the AWS SDK in their build \(ADR 0012\).
